'''Bleak Point Invasion''' was a battle fought in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] at [[Bleak Point Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. It was fought between the [[Theran]]s and the [[Newcomer]]s. The goal of the newcomers was to destroy, or at least disable, one of the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] stations to allow one of [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad's]] ships to get through the barrage.

==The battle==
The battle began when [[Beldorion]] unleashed a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] on the station. The Therans then took their defensive positions as the attackers climbed on the walls of the station. The battle was stopped when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] explained to the newcomers with the help of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and some documents that she gained from Ashgad's own computer.

===The chase===
A [[Gerney Caslo|rationalist]] was still able to throw explosives into the cannon, badly damaging it. Ashgad and [[Dzym]] were then able to flee in their ship. Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa Solo went to Seti Ashgad's house to get the Z-95 he kept in his hangar to chase him. It was then that Leia dueled with Beldorion. She finally killed him when Luke was lifting off and chasing Ashgad. He had almost reached the enemy ship when [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]]' ships attacked him. His ship fell into the atmosphere and crashed into the desert.

===Calling for help===
When Luke crashed on Nam Chorios, he was able to communicate with [[tsil]]s and convinced them to help him. They forced their captured brothers in the enemy [[Needle fighter|CCIR Needle]] to shoot at Ashgad's ship, destroying it, after which they fell into the planet's atmosphere.

===Aftermath===
At the station, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] reunited with Leia and Luke saw Callista, just saying her goodbye. They then climed into [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] shuttle and discussed the plan to destroy the [[Droch/Legends|droch]] that had already been sent to other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Cybloc XII/Legends|Cybloc XII]].
